intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Kolkata region of West Bengal. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

JIS College of Engineering vs University of Engineering & Management is a private comparison. JIS has the only NIRF 2025 Engineering rank on this page, at 201, and the only 2020 or later placement record.

sections.heading: JIS College of Engineering vs University of Engineering & Management for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JIS College of Engineering if you want a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 201 and a recorded 2023 year, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh.

Choose UEM if you have checked its latest official placement and fee notices. This page has no NIRF Engineering rank for UEM, and its latest recorded placement year is 2019, which we do not treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: JIS College of Engineering has recorded tuition from about ₹90,200 to ₹1.29 lakh a year, depending on the programme. Treat these as year fees, not confirmed four-year totals.

UEM's recorded rows include tuition of about ₹90,000 to ₹1.61 lakh a year, plus smaller exam, hostel and registration charges. Those smaller rows are not the flagship tuition and should not be used as the programme fee.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: JIS's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹8 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
UEM's latest recorded row here is from 2019, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹16 lakh. Because 2019 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both sides list JEE Main and WBJEE on this page. Most West Bengal private engineering seats are filled through WBJEE counselling, with some JEE Main seats as well.
Read the current WBJEE information bulletin for eligibility, domicile rules and counselling rounds.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in the Kolkata region of West Bengal. JIS College of Engineering is in Kalyani, in the wider Kolkata belt. UEM has a Kolkata-area campus of its own.
Visit both if the exact suburb, hostel and commute will decide the choice for you.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, JIS is the more documented side: a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 201 and a 2023 placement year.
UEM may still suit you after you see its current official placement report, but this page cannot show a post-2019 flagship result or an NIRF Engineering rank for it.
Do not use UEM's exam, hostel or registration rows as the B.Tech tuition. Confirm both official fee circulars.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, JIS College of Engineering or UEM, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: JIS has a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 201 and recorded 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and an ₹8 lakh highest package. UEM has no NIRF Engineering rank here and a 2019 placement row, which this page does not treat as current.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for JIS vs UEM?
faqs.answer: JIS tuition is recorded at about ₹90,200 to ₹1.29 lakh a year. UEM tuition is recorded at about ₹90,000 to ₹1.61 lakh a year. Smaller UEM exam, hostel and registration rows are not the programme tuition.

faqs.question: Do both colleges accept WBJEE and JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list JEE Main and WBJEE on this page. Confirm the current WBJEE bulletin for counselling rules.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for JIS and UEM?
faqs.answer: JIS has recorded 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and an ₹8 lakh highest package. UEM's latest recorded year here is 2019, which is not treated as a current flagship result.

faqs.question: Are JIS and UEM both in Kolkata?
faqs.answer: Both are in the Kolkata region of West Bengal, on different campuses. JIS College of Engineering is in Kalyani. Visit both if the exact location matters.
